oraclePlatform.referenceHost: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04 with r-lib/actions/setup-r r-version 4.6.1
oraclePlatform.note: Elementary-function last-place results are platform-dependent. Evidence must record the glibc version; evidence produced on another platform is advisory until rerun here.

advisory.purpose: Warn about regressions fixed on the release branch without redefining the normative target.
Canary for future language and API changes.
GNU R 4.6.1 for Windows x86_64 (UCRT) as a second oracle platform. It exposes platform-dependent libm and text-transport behavior without redefining the normative target.

platformProfile.definition: Behavioral compatibility is required wherever GNU R behavior is meaningful inside a capability-safe browser runtime. Browser-inapplicable behavior must use an explicit adaptation or fail closed.

adaptations.behavior: Require an explicit host command adapter; otherwise fail closed.
Operate on evaluator-owned virtual storage unless an explicit byte transport is supplied.
Return a stable NativR session identifier, never a host operating-system process identifier.
Report the documented browser runtime identity fields; host operating-system identity is outside the browser session.

Use real named-environment labels and session-owned nativr identifiers for anonymous environments. The AST interpreter emits no GNU bytecode or host-memory addresses. Function syntax, retained-source behavior, attributes, and reference identity remain behavioral contracts.
Report the facilities actually available to the NativR session.
Use registered capability-safe handles and audited Wasm adapters; never expose host pointers or ambient dynamic loading.
Compare semantic graphics operations and documented output profiles without claiming platform-device pixel identity.

Use NativR-owned correctly rounded binary64 implementations so every browser computes identical results. A last-place difference from the normative oracle is accepted only when an independent high-precision reference shows the NativR result is correctly rounded and the oracle's is not; it is recorded as oracle-libm-deviation and never normalized away.

Core namespaces are resident in every NativR session. Package checks that GNU R runs with R_DEFAULT_PACKAGES=NULL detach the default packages from the search path instead (RFC-0008); symbol visibility matches, but the core namespaces stay listed by loadedNamespaces().

adaptations.surface: package manual (R CMD check PDF version of manual)
adaptations.behavior: PDF typesetting needs a host LaTeX toolchain. The package-check manual stage renders every Rd file to text using only documented or package-defined Rd macros (RFC-0008) and does not claim PDF equivalence.

adaptations.surface: package vignettes and installed documentation (R CMD check vignette items)
adaptations.behavior: Re-building vignette outputs needs host Sweave/LaTeX or Pandoc, and PDF compression analysis needs host qpdf. The package-check vignettes stage runs the R code of each vignette on both runtimes, and the installed-documentation stage checks installed outputs, tangled code, source copies and PDF sizes (RFC-0008). Neither claims rebuilt-output equivalence.

upgradePolicy: Changing the normative GNU R version requires an explicit compatibility-profile change, regenerated evidence, and release-gating review. A moving release alias must not redefine behavior.
